csharpDecision: Entry I/O failure returns process status1. Ordinary generic scalar writer uses canonical process exit1 plus unreachable; declaration feature scan includes the scalar intrinsic. Unit/scalar/aggregate result ABI is never used for failure.
slgDecision: Canonical generic scalar emitFileCall delegates to void sollang_binary_write; binary open/write/close/open-reader use llvm.trap on failure. Replace those fail-fast traps with one target-aware exit1 helper while preserving Result-returning read failures and all source ABI/call ownership.
sourceRestrictions: Legacy openWriter wrappers and writeInt in ordinary functions remain rejected by semantic main-only policy. No effect or scope expansion.
